rows.text: A PMO release headed 'DR. LANGI KAVALIKU, DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER RETIRES' (after 34 years of service) says that 'Dr. S. Langi Kavaliku' is 'due for retirement, commencing on the 11th November 2000.'
rows.locator: Kavaliku item: heading and first paragraph
rows.uncertainty: A prospective announcement: 11 November 2000 is the day the retirement was due to commence, not a stated end of office, and no record retrieved confirms the day it took effect; no until is set. The item has no date line of its own (the index dates it 6/11/00), so this claim stores no structured date. The heading's length of service is given here in figures.

rows.text: The same release says: 'At the height of his career, Dr. Kavaliku was appointed the Deputy Prime Minister in 1991.'
rows.uncertainty: Retrospective and year only: it dates no appointment day, supplies no start and says nothing about who held the office on 1 January 1990. It is never a holder date or boundary.
